$comment: Domains this repository has PROVEN cannot serve a source, and the evidence. The positive registry is config/sources.json; this is its negative, and `scripts/check_retired_sources.py` fails if a retired domain is declared as a source again. It exists because the positive list cannot record a failure: a domain that stopped working looked identical to one that never did, so the correction lived only in a note and in whichever file happened to be edited that day. `references/approved-sources.md` MUST still be able to name a retired domain in its Notes column -- that is where the retirement is explained to a human -- so only the Domains column is checked there.

retired.reason: The league's former primary host. DNS still resolves, but every TLS handshake fails with `tlsv1 unrecognized name` on both the bare and the `www` host, so no request ever reaches a body. A plain GET returns nothing at all, which is why the BBL source could not produce a fixture and its `fixture_recall` contribution was permanently zero while the daily run reported a TLS error whose real cause was a stale URL.
retired.evidence: Measured on the bare and `www` hosts, 2026-09-17 and re-verified 2026-09-30. `scripts/fixtures.py` kept this URL long after the registry had been corrected, because nothing connected the registry to the fetcher -- that gap is now closed by `tests/test_fixtures.py::TestFixtureSourcesAreApproved`.

retired.reason: The Tier 5 table's Bamberg host since the tier was written. Every TLS handshake fails with SSLV3_ALERT_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE on the bare and www host; over plain HTTP it serves a page titled 'Stammtisch Bamberg Baskets', which is a supporters' club, not the club. The approved host is the club's own site.
retired.evidence: Bare and www probed over TLS and HTTP, 2026-11-27. `bamberg.basketball` answers 200 over TLS with the title 'Bamberg Baskets – Bamberg ist Basketball' and was in the same day's fetch pass.

retired.reason: The Tier 5 table's Ludwigsburg host. The name does not resolve at all, on the bare or the www host, so no request ever reached a server.
retired.evidence: getaddrinfo returns 'no address associated with hostname' for both names, 2026-11-27. `riesen-ludwigsburg.de` answers 200 with the title 'RIESEN Ludwigsburg | Barock Pirates Ludwigsburg e.V.'.

retired.reason: The Tier 5 table's Heidelberg host. The name does not resolve, on the bare or the www host.
retired.evidence: getaddrinfo fails for both names, 2026-11-27. `mlp-academics.de` answers 200 with the title 'MLP Academics Heidelberg'.

retired.reason: The Tier 5 table's Chemnitz host. The name does not resolve, so the club's site was never fetched under it.
retired.evidence: getaddrinfo fails for both names, 2026-11-27. `chemnitz99.de` answers with the NINERS Chemnitz site and is also the 'official website' on the EuroCup team page, so the replacement rests on two independent sources.

retired.reason: The Tier 5 table's Jena host. The name does not resolve, on the bare or the www host.
retired.evidence: getaddrinfo fails for both names, 2026-11-27. `baskets-jena.de` answers 200 with the title 'Startseite - Science City Jena'.

retired.reason: The Tier 5 table's MBC host. It is a misspelling of the club's name (the club is Mitteldeutscher BC, not BBC) and the doubled letter does not resolve.
retired.evidence: getaddrinfo fails for both names, 2026-11-27. `mitteldeutscherbc.de` answers 200 and redirects to `syntainics-mbc.de`, whose title is 'Startseite - MBC'.

retired.reason: The Tier 5 table's Hamburg host. The word order is the club's display name, not its domain, and the name does not resolve.
retired.evidence: getaddrinfo fails for both names, 2026-11-27. `hamburgtowers.de` answers 200 with the title 'Startseite | Veolia Towers Hamburg'.

retired.reason: The Tier 5 table's Rostock host. Every TLS handshake fails with SSLV3_ALERT_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE on the bare and www host; a plain HTTP request redirects to the club's real host, so the string never served a page over TLS.
retired.evidence: Bare and www probed over TLS and HTTP, 2026-11-27. HTTP redirects to `https://www.seawolves.de/`, which answers 200 over TLS with the title 'Startseite - seawolves.de'.

retired.reason: The Tier 5 table's Bonn host. The server presents a certificate whose hostname does not match, so the approved host could never be fetched over TLS.
retired.evidence: TLS fails with a hostname-mismatch verification error on the bare and www host, 2026-11-27. `telekom-baskets-bonn.de` answers 200 and redirects to `https://www.telekom-baskets-bonn.de/`, the club site.
